allocation: Product families, variants, crops and repeated scans stay together. Development exposure is permanent; calibration and held-out allocations remain proposed until independently reviewed and frozen.
comparisonPolicy: Pair every arm on the same inputs/references, fixed question/model/configuration/prompt, data snapshot and tool access. Record actual model, fallback, retries, recovery, failures and missing metadata. A model change invalidates that paired comparison, rather than silently pooling it.

measures: existing OCR scorer complete value-unit-basis correctness
families.recoveryPolicy: Initial extraction has no modality-changing recovery. Score subsequent autonomous recovery as a separate stage.
Same images/model/question; secondary OCR is the sole intended difference. OCR character volume is not an accuracy metric.
Freeze corpus IDs/hash and independent graded judgments. Identity, relevance and clinical/jurisdiction applicability are separate labels.
Blinded, independent human ratings 0–4; retain unsupported claims and rater disagreement. No automatic prose judge or clinical target inference.
Exercise existing application tools and saved state; injected fixtures establish contract behavior only.
Separate cold/warm, stage/task/conversation and source/server revision. Missing is unavailable, not zero; do not sum overlapping wall-clock intervals.
